newsitem.title: USA: Culp Inc files for 1.6 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Culp Inc files for 1.6 mln common shares.

text.p: Culp Inc said Thursday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 1.6 million common shares.

Of the total, 1.2 million are being offered by the company and 400,000 are for sale by certain shareholders, Culp said in the filing. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 12,540,577 common.

The selling shareholders have granted the underwriters a 30 day over-allotment option to purchase 240,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Wheat First Butcher Singer and Raymond James & Associates Inc.

Net proceeds will be used for expansion of facilities, equipment purchases, possible future acquitisions, repayment of debt, working capital and other general corporate purposes, Culp said in the filing.
Culp said it also received preliminary approval for listing on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "CFI.N"
Culp is a manufacturer and marketer of furniture upholstery fabrics and is a producer of mattress fabrics (known as mattress ticking).
